tools.name: general_task
tools.title: Run general-purpose Antigravity sub-agent task
tools.description: Delegate coding task to agy sub-agent (accept-edits mode, may edit files). Prompt must be self-contained. Blocks until finished, returning report (status, response, usage, files_touched, transcript paths). Default effort: medium. background: true returns handle immediately (collect with watch_task). conversation_id resumes earlier thread. Headless runs auto-deny gated tools (in denied_actions; auto_approve skips).

model.description: Model (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash). Tier-carrying id (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-high) encodes tier and wins over effort; pairing with different effort is refused locally.

effort.description: Effort: low|medium|high (bare models; tier-carrying ids win).

auto_approve.description: Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions to avoid auto-denying tools. Pair with sandbox.

edit_scope.description: Allowed edit paths; out-of-scope edits flag in scope_violations.

timeout_ms.description: Idle timeout in ms (0..3600000; 0 disables; default 900000).

background.description: Run in background; collect with watch_task. Emits no progress notifications.

tools.name: watch_task
tools.title: Watch live or recent task stream transcript
tools.description: Read transcript tail of an agy run (snapshot, not follow; no args = latest run). Digest: steps (50 most recent), step_count (total; step_count > steps.length means clipped), phase, elapsed_seconds, usage_latest, content (raw tail). Finished runs carry complete final result (failed run says why). wait: true blocks until finished in one call (not combinable with cancel; cannot await foreign run). cancel: true stops owned run (foreign/ambiguous reported ignored with hint).

stream_file.description: Transcript or task ID. Omit for latest run.

tail_lines.description: Trailing lines (1..2000, default 400; 0 returns all, capped at 200k chars).

cancel.description: Stop running task owned by this process and report cancelled.

wait.description: Block until finished and return result in one call. Incompatible with cancel; cannot await foreign run.

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List available agy models
tools.description: List models for model argument. Returns models (raw agy models output) and model_ids (parsed ids). CLI lists tier-carrying ids only; bare ids like gemini-3.8-flash are valid for model but not in list.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List available agy agents
tools.description: List agent profiles for agent argument. Returns agents (raw agy agents output). Empty output means no custom agent configured.
